div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Reads meeting artefacts;
writes via existing writers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Reads tool descriptors for
the prompt + grammar

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Runs device pairing + the
reconnect/lifecycle
(connected-gated, WS4-A S5b);
injects ConnectedTunnel as
IpcState.tunnel

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Reads/merges the
authoritative notes.ydoc via
NotesStore;
MeetingFolder::ensure for
inbound folders

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Scans candidates
(folder::list_meeting_ids)
and claims/renews/reaps via
the guarded
update_metadata_if re-export

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Injects the connected
SyncControl (ConnectedSync);
the free build wires
disabled_sync() instead
(connected-gated)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Wires SyncEngine into the
always-on hub daemon

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Wraps SyncEngine's transport
+ lifecycle surface via
UniFFI

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Reads/writes metadata.json +
notes.ydoc via the lifted
primitives (persistence-free)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Triggers Summarise; holds the
LLM substrate

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Builds the registry +
context; dispatches tools

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Holds the engine; drives the
turn loop

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Enqueues attachment
conversion jobs; calls
convert_to_markdown in the
bounded worker

Dispatches chunks via
AsrBackend trait (Parakeet

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
On stop: assigns speakers via
Diarizer trait
(authoritative); during
recording: live per-segment
labels via OnlineDiarizer
(additive)

Delegates the notes-CRDT
primitives; re-exports them

color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
System-provided audio input
device, surfaced through the
OS audio API (WASAPI /
CoreAudio / ALSA /
PulseAudio).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
GGUF and ONNX model files
cached under the app data
directory. Downloaded on
first run from a vendored
manifest.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Optional user-configured
local LLM backend reachable
over loopback HTTP. Default
disabled.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
React 19 + TypeScript +
Tiptap. The notes editor,
transcript pane, and meeting
controls. Runs inside the
Tauri webview.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Shared interface types and
trait definitions: Segment,
AudioChunk, MeetingId,
AsrBackend, Diarizer,
Summariser, error types. The
only crate every other
component is allowed to
depend on.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
cpal-backed capture loop.
Owns the audio device,
sample-rate negotiation, ring
buffer. Produces f32 frames
at a fixed internal sample
rate.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Silero VAD via vad-rs, plus
the smoothing wrapper.
Converts a frame stream into
silence-bounded AudioChunks
with start_ms / end_ms.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
llama-cpp-2 (mtmd module)
bound to Qwen3-ASR GGUF (0.6B
CPU default + optional 1.7B
GPU tier). Implements
AsrBackend. Owns the Qwen ASR
model lifecycle.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
sherpa-onnx
offline-transducer bound to
Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (English
+ 24 EU langs). Implements
AsrBackend with per-word
timestamps. Primary engine
for its languages;
orchestrator routes by
transcription language.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
sherpa-onnx integration.
Offline SherpaDiarizer
(implements Diarizer) is the
authoritative post-hoc pass
on buffered audio after stop.
Additive live OnlineDiarizer
labels VAD segments during
recording via embedding + a
pure online clusterer
(orchestrator-wired in Phase
B, best-effort, overwritten
by the on-stop pass).

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
llama-cpp-2 (text) for
summary generation.
Implements Summariser. Owns
the text-LLM model lifecycle;
also exposes the optional
external-LLM dispatcher.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Model download, hash
verification, on-disk
catalogue. Owns the model
cache directory; everything
that needs a model goes
through it.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Leaf carrying the notes-CRDT
primitives extracted from
persistence: the Yjs (yrs)
notes.ydoc + its
JSON/markdown projections
(NotesStore, ydoc), the
MeetingFolder layout, and the
metadata.json writer. No
libsql/audiopus/ogg, so sync
can transport the CRDT and
cross-compile to mobile.
persistence re-exports it at
the historical paths.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Per-meeting folder layout,
libsql index, Opus audio
encoding, Tiptap-JSON
storage. Owns disk and
database; delegates the
notes-CRDT primitives to
notes-crdt and re-exports
them.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
The live recording state
machine. Wires audio-capture
→ vad-chunker → asr-runtime →
persistence, emits typed
events for the UI. The only
crate that depends on
multiple other components.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Shared tool layer. One Tool
trait + ToolRegistry; the
single place a tool is
defined; driven by both the
chat agent and (Phase 10) the
MCP server.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Stateless, OpenAI-compatible,
tool-calling chat TURN engine
over the bundled local LLM.
Reuses the summariser model
substrate + the agent-tools
descriptors; the driver
(ipc-bridge) owns history +
the loop + tool dispatch.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
In-process Streamable HTTP
MCP server (loopback).
Projects the agent-tools
registry onto tools/list /
tools/call; bearer +
Host/Origin auth.
Settings-gated, off by
default.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
App-side half of the
connected-tier relay tunnel
(WS4-A). Dials the hosted
relay OUTBOUND over WSS,
re-implements the relay's
postcard wire frames, and
replays relayed MCP requests
against the loopback
mcp-server with the internal
bearer. No workspace edge;
connected-feature gated;
wired into app-main in S5.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Device-to-device sync engine
(WS4-B): iroh QUIC transport
over a custom SYNC_ALPN.
Exchanges Yjs notes-update
frames, content-addressed
meeting media (audio + note
assets, over a second
iroh-blobs ALPN), the
processing-lifecycle
Discovery exchange, and
derived-artifact
(transcript.json /
summary.md) reconciliation. A
near-leaf: depends only on
common + notes-crdt, never
persistence, which keeps its
lib cross-compilable to
mobile targets.
Connected-feature gated;
wired into app-main in S5.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Host-election state machine
for the producer gate
(WS4-B): claims a claimable
meeting (PendingProcessing,
or a Claimed past its lease)
with audio already synced in,
runs the pipeline, and writes
Processed — via the
ElectionDriver trait. A leaf
(common + persistence only):
the sync (advertise) and
orchestrator (process)
collaborators sit behind the
trait, so this crate takes no
edge to either and the one
state machine is reused by
both eligible host types.
Connected-feature gated;
wired into app-main in S4.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Settings schema, validation,
change notifications.
Persists via
tauri-plugin-store.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Converts attached document
bytes (PDF, XLSX, PPTX, HTML,
EML, ODS, txt/md) to
canonical markdown. Pure-Rust
in-process; catch_unwind
sandboxed; no OCR. Public
surface: convert_to_markdown
+ supported_exts.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Tauri command + event
surface. tauri-specta
generates the TypeScript
bindings consumed by the
webview's IPC client. The
only crate that knows about
Tauri APIs.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Tauri main binary. Wires
components, owns process
lifetime, handles tray icon
and window management.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Bundled native library
compiled with Vulkan / Metal
/ CPU backends. Used by both
ASR and summary LLMs via
llama-cpp-2.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Bundled native library for
diarization
(pyannote/segmentation-3.0
segmentation + 3D-Speaker
CAM++ embeddings +
clustering).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
SQLite file at
{app-data}/index.db. Mirrors
per-meeting metadata for fast
list + search.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Per-meeting directory under
{app-data}/meetings/{uuid}/.
Holds audio.opus,
transcript.json, notes.ydoc
(authoritative CRDT),
notes.json + notes.md
(derived), summary.md,
metadata.json.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
User-installed headless
daemon (minutist-hub). An
always-on sync hub other
devices converge through, and
post-launch a GPU processing
node. Pairs into the device
mesh like a desktop; holds
meeting plaintext in its own
data root, on hardware the
user owns. Optional; not the
relay.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
UniFFI wrapper over
sync::SyncEngine
(crates/sync-ffi),
cross-compiled to an
aarch64-linux-android cdylib
and bundled by the separate
phone companion app.
Mobile-only: not linked by
app-main or headless; a
workspace member built as its
own artifact, not part of the
Rust core process.
